decisions: Soft gate over hard lock (ratified): the frontier card is styled 'next arrival'; later anchors stay playable — coherence via storytelling, escalation to hard lock only if the M9.5 playtests show skipping breaks the season

os_engaged gates only the ambient channel, not story rules: every phone already opens through a moment (player-paced), so story gating would add nothing; the slow burn comes from ambient life + reading-speed prose + longer settles
Per-phone cadence profiles (Tita bursts / scammer rapid-fire) deferred with M8.3 — the island's data-state API is their natural diegetic surface; ambient + constants deliver the felt change now
voiceclone/assistant get no ambient beats: the voice-clone evening's compression IS its lesson (urgency is the weapon) and Anchor V's phones are short
Echo beats use distinct set-flags (vc_kk_echo etc.) so they fire exactly once and never block completion — same contract as kangkong's recognition beats
